item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Salutations one and all,
I go by JoysticKnight (I imagine you could shorten that to Jsk if it's a little much to type out).

I tend to be an avid enthusiast of design. I like to break apart the inner workings of all this world has to offer. Be it science, psychology, philosophy, art, traditional/video-games, or music to name a few large topics. Although, I do have a particular affinity towards music analysis, and game design.

As far as the foundation is concerned, I've seen it's growth over the years with the wealth of it's library and the troves of content people make concerning it. I indeed have adored the vast imagination of it's machinations showing thoroughly no true limit to the vastness of this world. And it's by this merit I have finally grown enough gall to even consider joining.

Personally speaking I tend to be a shelled and hermit-like in nature. So forgive me if it takes some time to flourish in any way. I have something of a social life, but tend to not act upon it, so participating in a forum or collective source is a rather new experience for me.

I hope that as time marches on I am able to contribute in some forward manner, gaining people's trust and flame of curiousity. Until then, I am but still just another peer.

Also I obvisouly don't talk with this much grandure in real life, it's just nice every once in a while to really convey the right emotions with fitting words.

So about that question. I suppose I'll go with water, it's an endlessly malleable substance that we learn does something new every 5 years or so. I admire it's ability to function and create function.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello there, name's Ascentimber, and I'm… here now, I guess.

I have heard of the SCP series since… maybe 2012? 2013? But I was only aware of it as an actual community and not just stories in 2016 or so. I guess I have lurked for some time after, but have just recently found the drive to contribute.

Personally, I have no ideas for SCPs as of yet, but I do plan to write on other things. My main interest here is to actually help the Indonesian SCP translation branch, but I will most likely still write something here. I am doing a lot of independent historical research as of the past year or so, so anything I write will probably be based on history.

If there's anything I would like to ask to any staff members that might reply to my introduction message is: 1. What are the current steps on writing SCPs? and, 2. What are the current steps on writing for the Log of Anomalous Items/Extranormal Events/Unexplained Locations?

Answering the random question, it's probably water. Probably because it's the least mismatching one of 'em all.

Anyhow, I would also like to thank the staffs for the acceptance, and a quick one too. It's almost instantaneous, I would say, unlike the two or three day period that the guide says will take.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello, my name is ShinxX, nice to meet you all.

I only recently got into SCP’s recently, I had heard of them before and seen some stories, but never really paid much attention to the overall idea or anything. Recently I saw some videos about various SCP’s and just the idea in general that got me more and more interested. I watched videos from The Rubber, thevolgun, etc. I’m now hooked and reading multiple SCP’s every day.

I’ve always had story ideas trapped in my head that I could never put to paper because of my lack of writing skills, plus I’ve never really been around experienced writers. With my joy of drawing, i hope to make my own webcomic I’m the future. A few story ideas I had I believe could work well as SCP’s and I hope to learn and improve my writing here to make great SCP’s and other stories in the future.

The element that represents me most would probably be earth, I’m usually down to earth and tend to be neutral when it comes to many things.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hi all! I'm AzureDisplay (Azure is also fine!). I've been lurking on the SCP wiki for a while (since 2015-ish) and have had quite a few ideas for articles of my own in the meantime. I'm generally kind of anxious about the idea of putting work of my own out there so it took me a while, but here we are!

Some of my biggest hobbies are playing video games, animation, and illustration. As far as potential SCPs I would write, I've always been a fan of the articles that hit just the right amount of weird to stick out in your memory but not so much to drift into "lul so randum" territory. Surreality and fridge horror are always top tier when done right.

Overall I'm excited to be here and interact with the community instead of just lurking in the shadows!

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey y'all.

My username is EVANCELION (like evangelion, but with a c instead of a g. No, I don't watch the anime), but you're free to call me Jesse (He/Him).

I've always lurked the site, because my friends and I have always loved SCP- probably since I was 12 or 13, so about 7 years- and it's always been a minor bucketlist goal of mine to get at least one canon SCP. I've got my sandbox page made and I'll tackle my ideas one by one over time, but I'm looking forward to meeting all of you and sharing some of my writing. Outside of writing, I thoroughly enjoy drawing in my free time, and I also like playing video games (though I'm sure most people here probably do).
As far as what element I'm closest to, I'd say fire. I'm overly-passionate about my favorite interests and loved ones, but I can get deflated, or doused, rather, pretty easily. Plus, I'm edgy, so, that's definitely also a factor.

Regardless, it's nice to finally be a member of this wiki. I'm looking forward to participating in the community!

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Explorers
item.content:encoded:
Hello fellow humans, at least two dogs and an army of birds,

I remember reading 173 when it was originally circulating, or I guess… trickling down from /x/ to reddit.
Now there are 6000 SCPs, so I read all 5561 of them. Probably. Last night I read Captain Kirby's "End of Death" series and I have several questions that cannot - and must not - be answered.

I hope I can contribute useful information about the wiki. I'm currently building a program that scrapes the wiki for specific page types, caches the "meat" of each one, and lets me perform offline, human-assisted analytics. When the proof of concept is done, I'll be able to tell you how many SCPs are "spooky broadcast receivers". Hint: It's a lot.

Mainly, I joined the wiki because the HP 28c does not have an equals>display button, and the notes should be updated to reflect correct use of Reverse Polish Notation.

QOTM: Fire. I am energetic, require care to manage, and must balance myself between burning down a forest and settling into embers.

item.title: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Gday, I am Endurian, I have wanted to join the SCP foundation for awhile because I tend to just create "anomalous" creatures in my head all the time but don't write about them, and just overthink them. and I think some people would like to read about what kind of creatures/items that I come up with. I have a few in mind now but they will need a experienced eye to see if my skills are on point. I look forward to hearing from some of you and improving in the future!

the element that would represent me is water. Because even though water seems simple enough, it is extremely powerful under the right circumstances. a tsunami can wipe out a city. water can erode rock and rust metal and high enough pressure of water can cut through steel!
